# Configuration directory of gitlab-tracker 0.6.0

Written by the code of the `v0.6.0` tag itself (its demo MRs saved with
`save_state_async`, its demo stats seeded into a file `stats.db`, its default
`config.json`), not by hand: `storage::tests::a_0_6_configuration_upgrades_*`
checks that the current version reads all of it on first launch.

Regenerate only for another released version, in a new directory named after it.
